claims: Assess and manage hypophosphatemia (phosphate 1.4 mg/dL), including continued phosphate repletion and repeat phosphate monitoring.
Monitor renal function with repeat creatinine and urine output given creatinine 1.3–1.5 mg/dL and BUN 26–27 mg/dL.
Monitor coagulation status with repeat PT/INR and PTT given INR 1.4–1.5 and PTT 32–34 sec.
Continue potassium repletion and monitor serum potassium given potassium 3.5–3.9 mEq/L.
Monitor serum calcium and magnesium given total calcium 7.1 mg/dL and magnesium 1.7–1.9 mg/dL.

Monitor respiratory status and oxygen saturation given respiratory rate up to 33 insp/min and oxygen saturation 96–98% on 2 L/min.
Continue incentive spirometry and cough/deep breathing exercises.
Monitor blood glucose given fingerstick glucose 91–121 mg/dL and serum glucose 105–106 mg/dL.
Maintain fall precautions and mobility assistance given bed rest status and secondary diagnosis.
